final: WITH regional AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amount, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS avg_regional_amount FROM regional) SELECT AVG(r.avg_amount) AS avg_amount, AVG(r.record_count) AS avg_record_count, AVG(r.avg_amount - o.avg_regional_amount) AS avg_difference FROM regional AS r JOIN overall AS o ON o.avg_regional_amount IS NOT NULL WHERE r.avg_amount > o.avg_regional_amount
